hero.title: 20+ years turning complex technology into clearer GTM decisions.
paragraphs: I’ve worked across Field CTO, solutions engineering, product marketing, channel leadership, technical sales, and executive communication.
That range matters because GTM problems rarely belong to one function. I’ve seen them from Product, Sales, partners, customers, and the executive room.

background.title: Technical enough to understand the product. Experienced enough to see the business problem.
paragraphs: My career has spanned enterprise infrastructure, cloud, IT operations, data, cybersecurity, storage, application modernization, and complex B2B software.
I’ve held roles including Field CTO, VP of Channel, Principal Solutions Engineer, Product Marketing Manager, and technical GTM advisor.
checklist: Harvard Master’s in Information Management Systems
MIT Executive Certificate in Innovation & Strategy
Executive, analyst, customer, partner, and field-facing experience
GTM work across companies including Dell/EMC, Panzura, Device42, and Freshworks
Part of four acquisition and M&A transitions across enterprise technology companies

why.title: GTM problems look different depending on where you sit.
paragraphs: Product sees capabilities. Sales sees deals. Marketing sees the story. Partners see what they can repeat. Executives see risk, growth, and priorities.

My advantage is that I’ve worked across those handoffs. That makes it easier to spot where the real problem is instead of treating every symptom like a messaging issue, a sales issue, or a partner issue.

human.title: Serious work can still be human.
paragraphs: I’m a husband, father of three, lifelong technology nerd, and someone who still gets excited when a company has built something genuinely useful.
I like direct conversations, practical advice, and working with people who care about solving the real problem instead of performing consultant theater.

close.title: Have a GTM problem that needs a sharper look?
paragraphs: Bring the concern. We can talk through what’s happening and figure out whether Successfulbob can help.
